notes.title: Workshop & Mini-Games
notes.notes:
Hey junglers! We are happy to announce that we are currently working on workshop addition so you guys will be able to submit your characters and get them inside the game through popular decision.

On the other hand, we are working on new scenarios so you will be able to play mini-games with your current avatar, get some extra prizes and [b]secret[/b] stuff.

We will be posting more about it in a few days.

Thanks for your support.

notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS ARE HERE!!
notes.notes:
Hey junglers! Hope y'all having a good day/night.

We are so pleased to announce that we finally dropped our first [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] pack!
Take a look! Now you have CLICKS & DROP achievement milestones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136391/88298d5e07508e948061346dd1adabb8c8a69bb2.png[/img]

As we told you guys earlier, we were working on this and on Workshop items to extend our art community and to let you challenge each other in order to have your avatar in-game. Of course through a poll votation. [i]vox populi[/i]

I hope you all have a nice day. And, you know, [b]STAY TUNED[/b].

[i]see you around.[/i]
neo

notes.title: Update v2.1.0 Changelog!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! Hope y'all doing great.

Introducing changes:
[list]
[*] Improved optimization around clicks functionality. Now you can easily use macros or 3rd party software for +4hs without the game getting into "Not responding" state.
[*] Several UI Improvements, like new buttons to access features like directly "sell" an item from the inventory item details view, new button icons, effects over the game.
[*] "Cash" sound now playing when a new drop comes in (with the confetti explosion).
[*] Join Discord button added to the main scene!
[/list]
----
Now we will be focused on a big update where steam achievements will come in, workshop additions, and MORE!.
[b]Stay tuned![/b]

See you around on our Discord!
https://discord.gg/8uQkmJx4Fy

neo.

notes.title: New Rare/Legendary drop schedule
notes.notes:
We've changed our drop interval rate from 15h to 3h for rare & legendary items.
So, with that, the active drop schedule is:
[list]
[*] [b]Every 2.5h (2 and a half hours): Common drop[/b]. (80% chances using Common Avatar, 90% using a Rare, and 100% using a Legendary one).
[*] [b]Every 3h (3 hours): Rare/Legendary drop[/b]. (Chances affected by Active Avatar's habitat and rarity boost).
[/list]

Thank you so much for your support!
